title: Testing Mullet's NEW 4,000hp Big Block
coverage: full transcript read (0:00-28:58); ~20:40 onward is turbo-giveaway calls (Precision 64/66, 76, 88 sizes) with no car-build data
notes: 4,000hp is title-only. Track is the FL2K venue (event said to start tomorrow, then 'FL2K baby' at track).

cars.build_version: Mullet tall-deck big block, first test (big tire, non-lockup converter)

engine.notes: Red oil from previous blown big block found in catch can (forgot to drain) - not a new-engine failure

power_adder.notes: New 'giant' turbos; first body drop with them; bullhorns built out the side; one wastegate tube re-clocked

ecu.tuner: Pete (tune); Pete instructed to run to 330 ft if it felt good

rear_end.notes: Driver felt possible ring gear damage after pass; to inspect via fill hole

weight_lb.target: ~3,000 lb car plus driver ~200+ lb to reach class weight

passes.desc: First hit on new engine, FL2K venue, full class weight, non-lockup converter
passes.notes: Driver likely lifted before 330 ft and rolled to the eighth

failures.cause: unusual per-tooth noise felt after pass; not confirmed
oil puked out - old engine oil left in can

targets.class: same setup intended for World Cup (weight, converter)

chassis_mods.fact: New billet CNC front motor plate made by Ty on his home CNC router (Shapeoko 5 Pro 4x4, 2.2 kW water-cooled spindle; caption 'Shapokco')

cars.owner_driver: unidentified (friend in shop; possibly class racer)

engine.heads: cast 'B2' heads from a brand garbled as 'mass Moses' (possibly Mast Motorsports; low confidence)
engine.notes: Owner spray-paints billet parts so they look non-billet; says rules don't prohibit it
